title: Added missing indexes for GP historical snapshot
summary: Added missing indexes to three GP historical snapshot staging tables to improve query performance during data migration.
key_points: Added CUSTNMBR, APTODCTY, APTODCNM indexes to GPRM20201 and GPRM30201 tables
Added IVDOCTYP, DOCNUMBR, LNSEQNBR indexes to GPIVSerialLotNumberHist table
Indexes improve performance of lookups and joins on these staging tables
Affects GP historical snapshot data migration tables
quote: This PR adds missing indexes to the following GP historical snapshot related staging tables.
